hero.headline: Measure Your Brand Awareness.
hero.body:
BrandPulse reads the mentions you already have — CSV exports, copied messages and RSS feeds,
separates real complaints from everyday chatter, and shows what needs a reply today.
hero.note: Built for small and medium businesses in Azerbaijan and beyond.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Separating signal from noise in three simple steps.

bringIn.title: Bring your mentions in
bringIn.description: Upload a CSV export, paste messages by hand, or subscribe to an RSS feed. No social media logins, ever.

reads.title: BrandPulse reads them
reads.description: Each mention gets a sentiment, a language (EN/AZ/RU) and a topic. Complaints are separated from ordinary chatter.

act.title: Act on what matters
act.description: Related complaints are grouped into incident threads and scored, so you can answer the loudest problem first.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything BrandPulse does today, without the enterprise baggage.

clustering.title: Incident clustering
clustering.body: Related complaints are grouped into a single thread, so twenty separate messages about one cold meal read as one problem — not twenty.

priority.title: Priority scoring
priority.body: Every thread is scored on how negative it is, how far it could travel and how fast it is growing — then labelled Low to Critical.

multilingual.title: Multilingual
multilingual.body: Azərbaycan dili, Русский, English — complaint rules tuned per language, not translated after the fact.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.body: There is no social network monitoring and no password sharing. You upload, paste or subscribe to a feed — the text stays inside your own instance.

useCases.title: Use cases
useCases.subtitle: The complaints look different depending on what you sell, so the examples do too. Pick the one closest to your business.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when one person can no longer keep up on their own.

finalCta.title: Ready to hear what really matters?
finalCta.body: Start with the free Demo plan, paste in a handful of real messages and see what BrandPulse picks out. No payment is taken.
